title: geranium lamberti var. backhousianum
intro: Geranium lamberti var. backhousianum, commonly known as Chinese Geranium or Red Geranium, is a plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family, known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Geranium lamberti var. backhousianum include its ability to stimulate the lymphatic system, promote hormonal balance, and exhibit sedative and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
